issue.title: Stale Tip Relay (BIP 332) tracking issue
issue.body:
[BIP 332](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0332.md) adds an optional `staletip` P2P message for announcing recent stale chain tips to peers that negotiated it via BIP 434.

Full branch: https://github.com/pseudoramdom/bitcoin/tree/bip332-staletip-relay
Discussion: https://groups.google.com/g/bitcoindev/c/AwOPNxF15mU

## Plan

### Implementation

- [ ] **PR 1 - Local tracking and RPC** 
  - Validation notification, report cached stale tips in RPC.
  - No P2P change
- [ ] **PR 2 - Headers-mode relay**
  - `staletip` message, BIP 434 negotiation.
  - Relays headers only, enough to observe stale rates.
- [ ] **PR 3 - Stale-branch blocks**
  - Serve available blocks on tracked stale branches
  - `-staletips=blocks` additionally downloads them, as best-effort requests.
- [ ] Fuzz tests
- [ ] Release note and `doc/bips.md` entry
- [ ] Update the reference implementation link in the BIP

### Live tests
  - [x] Regtest simulation - https://github.com/pseudoramdom/staletip-lab
  - [ ] Mainnet
  - [ ] Signet
  - [ ] Testnet4

## Open questions
- [ ] Does relaying stale block data affect mining incentives? See the [mailing list discussion](https://groups.google.com/g/bitcoindev/c/AwOPNxF15mU)
